工具清单（15）

  • list_prompts — Fetch prompts from LangSmith with optional filtering. Args: is_public (str): Filter by prompt visibility - "true" for public prompts, "false" for private pro
  • get_prompt_by_name — Get a specific prompt by its exact name. Args: prompt_name (str): The exact name of the prompt to retrieve Returns: Dict containing the prompt details and
  • push_prompt — Call this tool when you need to understand how to create and push prompts to LangSmith. This is a documentation-only tool that explains how to: - Create prompt
  • get_thread_history — Retrieve one page of message history for a specific conversation thread. Uses char-based pagination: pages are built by character budget (max_chars_per_page).
  • fetch_runs — Fetch LangSmith runs from one or more projects with flexible filters and automatic pagination. All results are paginated by character budget to keep responses
  • list_projects — List LangSmith projects with optional filtering and detail level control. Args: limit (int): Maximum number of projects to return (default: 5) project_name
  • get_billing_usage — Fetch organization billing usage (trace counts) with workspace names inline. Args: starting_on (str): Start of date range (ISO 8601) ending_before (str): E
  • list_experiments — List LangSmith experiment projects (reference projects) with mandatory dataset filtering. Requires either reference_dataset_id or reference_dataset_name. Args
  • list_datasets — Fetch LangSmith datasets. If no arguments are provided, all datasets will be returned. Args: dataset_ids (str, optional): Dataset IDs as JSON array string o
  • list_examples — Fetch examples from a LangSmith dataset with advanced filtering options. Either dataset_id, dataset_name, or example_ids must be provided. Args: dataset_id
  • read_dataset — Read a specific dataset from LangSmith. Either dataset_id or dataset_name must be provided. Args: dataset_id (str, optional): Dataset ID to retrieve datas
  • read_example — Read a specific example from LangSmith. Args: example_id (str): Example ID to retrieve as_of (str, optional): Dataset version tag or ISO timestamp
  • create_dataset — Call this tool when you need to understand how to create datasets in LangSmith. This is a documentation-only tool.
  • update_examples — Call this tool when you need to understand how to update dataset examples in LangSmith. This is a documentation-only tool.
  • run_experiment — Call this tool when you need to understand how to run experiments and evaluations in LangSmith. This is a documentation-only tool.
